name: codegraph-mcp-server
description: Deterministic, explainable call graph for TS/JS and Python repos — who-calls, impact with evidence chains, tracing, cycles. CLI + MCP stdio.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=['bin/codegraph','bin/codegraph.exe'].filter(fs.existsSync);if(bad.length){console.error('bin 里有残留二进制（会把旧版本打进 tarball）,先删除:',bad);process.exit(1)}"
